transcript.answer: Before 2026-09-23 Gemini pods ran with 0 tools because gemini-cli takes no MCP flag and only reads MCP servers from its settings files. The subsystem rendered a recipe's `mcp_servers` only for Claude, so Gemini pods got no Lore MCP at all. Subsystem v0.11.2 tried to fix this by writing a system-scope settings file (`/agent/.ai-agent/gemini-settings.json`, pointed to by `GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH`). gemini-cli refused that file with the warning 'Parent directory is not owned by root (uid 0). Current uid: 1000', because the pod runs as uid 1000. It then started with '(0 tools)'. Subsystem v0.11.3 fixed this by merging the servers into the user settings file `/agent/.gemini/settings.json`. That was proven on 2026-09-23.
sources: CLAUDE.md (Task Pipeline, live agent MCP access)

judgements.reason: The answer says v0.11.2 wrote MCP servers to a system-scope settings file that gemini-cli refused under uid 1000, and that v0.11.3 moved them to /agent/.gemini/settings.json, which matches the gold answer.
